# Pull Request

## What Changed
- List files changed
- Purpose

## Why
- Link to issue: Fixes #...
- Phase relevance

## Owner Agent Type
- e.g., Fullstack Builder, SEO Content, etc.

## How Tested
- [ ] `docker compose up --build` works (if applicable)
- [ ] Tests pass (pytest, npm build)
- [ ] No secrets added
- [ ] Manual test steps:

## Checklist
- [ ] No direct commit to main, feature branch only
- [ ] No force-push, no history rewrite
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, API keys, wallet addresses
- [ ] No medical/legal/psychological authority claims
- [ ] No unsafe autonomous behavior (spending, publishing, contacting customers, changing pricing/config without approval)
- [ ] PR description includes: tools used, cost if any, approval needed, risks, rollback plan
- [ ] If persona: QA and red teaming report attached, compliance review if High risk
- [ ] If publishing/spending/pricing/config/API keys/persona sensitive edits: label `needs-human-approval` and founder approval comment

## Tools Used
- e.g., GitHub branch, Python, FastAPI, external LLM API

## Cost
- Tokens / USD if any - requires approval if >0 in Phase 0

## Approval Needed
- [ ] Merge PR (founder)
- [ ] Publishing public content
- [ ] Spending money
- [ ] Other: ___

## Risks
- Low/Medium/High + description

## Rollback Plan
- e.g., git revert <sha>, delete draft file, revoke API key, unpublish

## Screenshots / Logs (if UI)

## Next Steps
- QA review, founder approval, etc.

## Related Docs
- Link to relevant docs/roadmap, docs/agents, docs/personas
